correctness.rationale: The algebraic geometric-smoothness test requires A*B*C nonzero, all three axial discriminants nonzero and det M != 0 in F5 where M=[[2A,D,E],[D,2B,F],[E,F,2C]]. This criterion handles singularities over algebraic closure, not only rational points. A rational line yields a square geometric contact divisor iff its binary quartic is proportional to a square of a binary quadratic over F5; the quadratic discriminant splits hyperflex, rational pair and conjugate pair. The independent modular reimplementation exhausts all (5^6-1)/4=3906 normalized sextuples, finds all 800 smooth and checks each of the 31 rational lines, matching 15 signatures and seven 16-bitangent extremizers. This exhausts the finite parameter universe claimed, with no inference to all quartics or other fields.
